description: Mouse conditional knockout phenotype atlas for Atp6ap2 alongside human tissue expression
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Panel A: mouse Atp6ap2 conditional knockouts, organ-level outcome
# Source: MGI allele records + primary papers (PMIDs in labels)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
cko = pd.DataFrame([
    ("Cardiomyocyte",      "Myh6-Cre",     "Lethal heart failure ~3 wk",            20570919, "lethal"),
    ("Podocyte",           "NPHS2-Cre",    "Nephrotic syndrome, death <4 wk",       22034640, "lethal"),
    ("Nephron progenitor", "Six2-Cre",     "Reduced nephron number",                26658320, "severe"),
    ("Ureteric bud",       "Hoxb7-Cre",    "Renal hypodysplasia",                   23704941, "severe"),
    ("Renal tubule",       "Mx1-Cre",      "Distal renal tubular acidosis",         27044666, "severe"),
    ("Forebrain neuron",   "Camk2a-Cre",   "Synapse loss, neurodegeneration",       26376863, "severe"),
    ("Photoreceptor",      "Crx-Cre",      "Retinal disorganisation",               24305829, "severe"),
    ("Hepatocyte",         "dox-inducible","Endocytic/autophagic vacuoles",         28129027, "cellular"),
    ("Pancreatic beta",    "Ins-Cre",      "Multigranular vacuoles, glucose defect",31527264, "cellular"),
    ("T cell",             "Cd4-Cre",      "Blocked T-cell development",            26063165, "severe"),
    ("Osteoclast",         "LysM-Cre",     "Trabecular bone loss",                  39400061, "cellular"),
    ("Smooth muscle",      "SM-Cre",       "Aortic sclerosis, autophagic death",    24830537, "cellular"),
    ("Whole body (adult)", "CAG-CreER",    "Rapid lethality, marrow hypoplasia",    28851918, "lethal"),
], columns=["tissue","cre","phenotype","pmid","severity"])

col = {"lethal":"#b2182b", "severe":"#ef8a62", "cellular":"#67a9cf"}
order = {"lethal":0, "severe":1, "cellular":2}
cko = cko.sort_values(["severity","tissue"], key=lambda s: s.map(order) if s.name=="severity" else s)

fig, (axA, axB) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(16.5, 7.2),
                               gridspec_kw={"width_ratios":[1.35, 1]})
y = np.arange(len(cko))[::-1]
axA.barh(y, [1]*len(cko), color=[col[s] for s in cko.severity], height=0.72)
for yi, (_, r) in zip(y, cko.iterrows()):
    axA.text(0.02, yi, f"{r.tissue}  ({r.cre})", va="center", ha="left",
             fontsize=9.5, color="white", fontweight="bold")
    axA.text(1.03, yi, f"{r.phenotype}   PMID {r.pmid}", va="center", ha="left", fontsize=9)
axA.set_xlim(0, 3.05); axA.set_ylim(-0.8, len(cko)-0.2)
axA.axis("off")
axA.set_title("A  Mouse Atp6ap2 conditional knockouts: every tissue tested fails\n"
              "(MGI:1917745, floxed alleles tm1.1Aich and tm1.1Ics)",
              fontsize=11.5, loc="left")
handles = [plt.Rectangle((0,0),1,1,color=col[k]) for k in ["lethal","severe","cellular"]]
axA.legend(handles, ["organism or organ lethal", "severe organ dysfunction",
                     "cellular vacuolation / dysfunction"],
           loc="lower right", fontsize=9, frameon=False)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Panel B: Human Protein Atlas consensus RNA (nTPM)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
hpa = pd.Series({
    "Parathyroid gland":719.4, "Thyroid":166.0, "Kidney":154.5, "Bone marrow":117.4,
    "Cerebral cortex":109.4, "Placenta":100.4, "Liver":90.5, "Lung":82.3, "Colon":77.7,
    "Hippocampus":69.0, "Skin":68.0, "Adrenal gland":67.5, "Esophagus":65.8, "Spleen":65.0,
    "Heart muscle":51.6, "Pancreas":50.2, "Stomach":46.4, "Small intestine":45.0,
    "Salivary gland":39.6, "Testis":37.7, "Pituitary":34.0, "Duodenum":30.3,
}).sort_values()
affected = {"Kidney","Cerebral cortex","Liver","Hippocampus","Heart muscle","Bone marrow"}
cols = ["#b2182b" if t in affected else "#bdbdbd" for t in hpa.index]
axB.barh(hpa.index, hpa.values, color=cols)
axB.set_xlabel("consensus RNA, nTPM (Human Protein Atlas, ENSG00000182220)", fontsize=10)
axB.set_title("B  ATP6AP2 is expressed in every tissue\n"
              "red = organ affected in patients or mouse models", fontsize=11.5, loc="left")
axB.tick_params(axis="y", labelsize=9)
for s in ["top","right"]: axB.spines[s].set_visible(False)
axB.text(719.4*0.98, len(hpa)-1, " tissue-enriched (Tau 0.35)",
         va="center", ha="right", fontsize=8.5, color="white", fontweight="bold")

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

print(cko.severity.value_counts().to_string())
print(f"\nHPA nTPM range {hpa.min():.1f} to {hpa.max():.1f}; median {hpa.median():.1f}; "
      f"fold parathyroid over median {hpa.max()/hpa.median():.1f}x")
